subject: Supplier onboarding: aligning PO & payment cadence (Net terms + early-pay option)
messages:
From: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@atlascorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atlascorp.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasCorp vendor onboarding / payment terms request

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the fast responses so far — happy to start the vendor setup. Attached is our completed Atlas vendor onboarding form and a copy of our W-9 for Redwood Accounts Payable. A couple of things to align on before we finish: 

- Our org typically requests Net 60 for new vendors due to internal cash conversion timelines. Would Redwood be open to Net 60?
- Alternatively, we can do Net 30 if an early-pay option is available (we can accept a 1.0% discount for payment in 10 days).
- We need to confirm whether you require a PO before the first invoice or whether a contract/SOW plus invoice suffices.

Can you confirm Redwood's standard PO/payment flow and whether you have an early-pay program we can opt into? Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Sophie Chen
Vendor Relations | AtlasCorp
procurement@atlascorp.com

Attachments: Atlas_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf), W-9_AtlasCorp.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@atlascorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasCorp vendor onboarding / payment terms request

Hi Sophie — thanks for sending the forms over and for the clear options. Quick answers and next steps below.

- Standard Redwood payment term is Net 30. For new vendors we can consider Net 45 on a case-by-case basis, but Net 60 is outside our usual onboarding cadence without finance approval.
- We do offer an early-pay program: we can do Net 30 with a 1.5% discount if AtlasCorp elects 10-day accelerated payment (we call it FastPay). Alternatively, Net 45 with 1.0% 15-day early-pay is also an option if you need longer payment runway. 
- Regarding POs: Redwood prefers to issue a PO before the first invoice for services that will be ongoing. For one-off professional services tied to an SOW, we can accept a signed SOW + invoice and then issue a PO internally for tracking. Please indicate which you prefer so Marissa and I can configure the vendor profile.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm which term you prefer (Net 30 w/1.5% 10-day FastPay OR Net 45 w/1.0% 15-day).
2) If you want the PO-before-invoice route, confirm the bill-to and remit-to addresses and the contact for PO referencing.
3) Once confirmed, Marissa will create your vendor record and provide the ACH form for payments (we do ACH + wire depending on account setup).

Looping in Marissa (AP) and Jonas (legal) for any contract/PO template notes. Happy to schedule 20 minutes if you'd rather walk through.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

--

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the clear options. After speaking with our finance team, AtlasCorp would prefer to take Net 45 with the 1.0% early-pay at 15 days. That gives us the runway we need while still providing some benefit for faster payment.

A couple of follow-ups:
- We would like a PO before the first invoice if that's Redwood's preference. Please advise what information you need on the PO (PO number format, billing codes, or SOW reference).
- We'll complete your ACH form — can you share it and confirm the contact for remittance questions?

I'll attach the signed onboarding form in this reply (signed page only). Let us know if you require anything else.

Best,
Sophie

> Attachments: Atlas_Vendor_Onboarding_Form_signed.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie.chen@atlascorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasCorp vendor onboarding / payment terms request

Hi Sophie — great, Net 45 with 1.0% 15-day early-pay is acceptable. Confirming next steps and what's attached: 

1) PO and referencing
- Redwood will issue a PO number once the vendor record is created in our AP system. Please include the following on the PO request: vendor legal name (AtlasCorp), remit-to (will be in the ACH form), SOW reference (if any), and the contact email for invoice submission (in your case procurement@atlascorp.com).
- PO number format: REDW-2027-[sequential id]. We'll send the PO back in reply to this thread.

2) ACH form + remittance
- Marissa will send an ACH form to procurement@atlascorp.com for bank details. We require bank confirmation (micro-deposit or bank letter) for first-time vendors.

3) Contract/SOW / PO flow
- Because you requested a PO before invoicing for ongoing services, please provide the SOW reference when you invoice. If the engagement is milestone-based, note milestones on the invoice and reference the PO.

4) FastPay setup
- We'll enable the early-pay option in our vendor profile. When an invoice is submitted, Finance will evaluate it for the 15-day early-pay 1.0% discount program and apply the accelerated payment if both sides confirm the discount on the invoice.

Attached is a short confirmation stub for your records and the internal ticket we'll use to track setup. Marissa — can you open the vendor record and follow up with the ACH form and expected timeline (we typically set up first-time vendors within 7–10 business days pending bank confirmation)? Jonas — flag if any PO clauses need redlining.

Sophie, please confirm you (or procurement@atlascorp.com) received this and we'll move the PO creation forward.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

Attachments: Vendor_Setup_Confirmation.pdf (application/pdf)
